name: neon-royale
description: Battle royale neon minimalista — multiplayer em rede local pelo navegador

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n servidor,cliente -c blue,green "tsx watch server/src/index.ts" "vite --config client/vite.config.ts"
scripts.build: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && vite build --config client/vite.config.ts && node scripts/build-servidor.mjs
